title: 03. Embeddings & Vector DBs: ChromaDB WITHOUT LangChain (Native Client)
summary: ChromaDB WITHOUT LangChain (Native Client): CHAPTER 2: ChromaDB Native Client — No LangChain Install: pip install chromadb; In-Memory Client (no persistence).

sections.title: Introduction
sections.body:
**What this code covers**

- CHAPTER 2: ChromaDB Native Client — No LangChain Install: pip install chromadb
- In-Memory Client (no persistence)
- Persistent Client (saves to disk)
- HTTP Client (remote server)
- Client_http = chromadb.HttpClient(host="localhost", port=8000)
- Default: Chroma uses sentence-transformers (all-MiniLM-L6-v2) locally
- Get existing collection (raises if not found)
- Get or create (safe — won't raise if exists)

```python name=00_theory/02_chroma_native_basics.py
"""
CHAPTER 2: ChromaDB Native Client — No LangChain
Install: pip install chromadb
"""

import chromadb
from chromadb.utils import embedding_functions

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2.1 CLIENT TYPES
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── In-Memory Client (no persistence) ─────────────
client_memory = chromadb.Client()
print("✅ In-memory client created")

# ── Persistent Client (saves to disk) ─────────────
client_disk = chromadb.PersistentClient(path="./chroma_db/native")
print("✅ Persistent client created at ./chroma_db/native")

# ── HTTP Client (remote server) ───────────────────
# client_http = chromadb.HttpClient(host="localhost", port=8000)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2.2 EMBEDDING FUNCTIONS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Default: Chroma uses sentence-transformers (all-MiniLM-L6-v2) locally
default_ef = embedding_functions.DefaultEmbeddingFunction()

# OpenAI embeddings
openai_ef = embedding_functions.OpenAIEmbeddingFunction(
    api_key="your-api-key",
    model_name="text-embedding-3-large",
)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2.3 COLLECTION OPERATIONS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
client = chromadb.Client()  # in-memory for demo

# Create collection
col = client.create_collection(
    name="my_docs",
    metadata={"hnsw:space": "cosine"},  # distance metric
    embedding_function=default_ef,
)
print(f"✅ Collection created: {col.name}")

# Get existing collection (raises if not found)
# col = client.get_collection("my_docs")

# Get or create (safe — won't raise if exists)
col2 = client.get_or_create_collection(
    name="my_docs",
    metadata={"hnsw:space": "cosine"},
)

# List all collections
all_cols = client.list_collections()
print(f"📋 Collections: {[c.name for c in all_cols]}")

# Delete collection
# client.delete_collection("my_docs")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2.4 ADD DOCUMENTS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
col.add(
    ids=["id1", "id2", "id3"],
    documents=[
        "Python is a high-level programming language.",
        "JavaScript runs natively in web browsers.",
        "Rust provides memory safety without garbage collection.",
    ],
    metadatas=[
        {"language": "python", "type": "compiled", "year": 1991},
        {"language": "javascript", "type": "interpreted", "year": 1995},
        {"language": "rust", "type": "compiled", "year": 2010},
    ],
)
print(f"✅ Added 3 documents. Count: {col.count()}")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2.5 QUERY (SIMILARITY SEARCH)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
results = col.query(
    query_texts=["Which language is best for web development?"],
    n_results=2,
    include=["documents", "metadatas", "distances"],
)
print("\n🔍 Query Results:")
for i, (doc, meta, dist) in enumerate(zip(
    results["documents"][0],
    results["metadatas"][0],
    results["distances"][0],
)):
    print(f"  [{i+1}] dist={dist:.4f} | {doc} | meta={meta}")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2.6 GET (FETCH BY ID)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
fetched = col.get(ids=["id1", "id2"])
print(f"\n📄 Fetched: {fetched['documents']}")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2.7 UPDATE DOCUMENTS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
col.update(
    ids=["id1"],
    documents=["Python 3.12 is a modern, high-level programming language with type hints."],
    metadatas=[{"language": "python", "type": "interpreted", "year": 1991, "version": "3.12"}],
)
print("\n✏️  Updated id1")

# UPSERT (insert if not exists, update if exists)
col.upsert(
    ids=["id4", "id1"],
    documents=[
        "Go is a statically typed language designed by Google.",
        "Python is loved for its simple and readable syntax.",
    ],
    metadatas=[
        {"language": "go", "type": "compiled", "year": 2009},
        {"language": "python", "type": "interpreted", "year": 1991},
    ],
)
print(f"✅ Upserted. New count: {col.count()}")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2.8 DELETE DOCUMENTS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
col.delete(ids=["id3"])
print(f"\n🗑️  Deleted id3. Count: {col.count()}")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2.9 PEEK (preview first N records)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
peek = col.peek(limit=2)
print(f"\n👀 Peek: {peek['documents']}")
```
